import numpy as np, pyarrow as pa
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
k = rng.integers(0, 6, 20000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (6, 30))
data = centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (20000, 30))
df = pa.table({f'x{i}': pa.array(data[:, i].tolist()) for i in range(30)})
df = df.append_column('cluster', pa.array([f'c{v}' for v in k]))
